test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four parts. Identify the part that contains a grammatical error.

Surprisingly!/ dark chocolates/ are most bitterer/ in taste.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The main issue in the sentence lies in the usage of the comparative adjective **"bitterer".**
 
• The word "bitter" follows the standard comparative form **"more bitter"** instead of "bitterer."
 
• The term "most bitterer" is incorrect because "most" is used for superlatives, not comparatives.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"are the most bitter"** or **"are more bitter"**, depending on the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Surprisingly! dark chocolates are the most bitter in taste."*
